test_added: .sandcastle/boundary.test.mts: fails when a generic module carries a repo literal (zig / sudoku / AGENTS.md / the parity spellings), reads a project file by a path it names itself, calls process.cwd(), spawns a subprocess or imports the adapter; a self-test plants each violation to prove the checker matches, and a last test checks the adapter's facts name real files.
concerns: docs/agents/sandcastle.md has two `## Files` headings in a row (the new '## The project seam' section adds one above the existing one at lines 133-134), so the manual renders a duplicated section.

CONTEXT.md ('Project config') and docs/agents/sandcastle.md:122-125 say the eight generic modules take `ProjectConfig` as a value, but ledger.mts, resume.mts and events.mts never receive it -- they take only `runsDir`/file strings (ledger.mts:25, events.mts:34-61, resume.mts:31) -- so the docs overstate the seam the commit message describes correctly.

docs/adr/0022-sandcastle-harness-boundaries.md:31 says `ProjectConfig` carries 'step and criterion syntax'; project_config.mts has no such field and plan.mts still hard-codes `## Steps` and the checkbox shape (plan.mts:12,68,75), so the issue's 'implementation matches ADR-0022' criterion is not met.
